entries.b839755293d165a2: The company sets out the vision “Deliver what you want to say to those who want to know” and states that it values the stance of “Creator First, Individual First,” its policy since its founding. The company states that it will strengthen the functions of the Platform Business, its core business, and develop new services, aiming to further expand its business through synergies with the Media Advertising Business. In the Platform Business, it aims to increase the number of new creators and paying readers by promoting sales activities to acquire new creators and enhancing its support system, and in the Media Advertising Business, it aims to increase total page views by expanding content on its 4 existing media. On October 1, 2025, the company revised its management philosophy system, and it states that it will continue measures to support distribution using generative AI technology and to improve usability.
entries.c49cfb7f13c3f35c: A reportable segment that operates the newsletter distribution platform “Magmag!” and the fan community platform “MagOne (Maguwan)”; it has been the core business since the company was founded.
